chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day"
then let him not send his wife to the bathhouse.

key_terms.اللَّهِ: Allah, the One in whom belief is affirmed
key_terms.الْحَمَّامِ: the bathhouse; a public place for bathing
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ: the Last Day, the Day of final return and accountability
key_terms.يُؤْمِنُ: believes; holds faith in a way that should shape conduct

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about sending one’s wife to the bathhouse?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ties conduct within family life to faith in Allah and the Last Day. The hadith instructs a believing man not to send his wife to the public bathhouse, presenting this as a matter of religiously guided propriety and accountability before Allah.
